tool.name: WGCNA: Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis
tool.description: Co-expression modules, GO enrichment, and cross-condition network preservation
tool.command:
mkdir -p cytoscape_output enrichment_output &&
## Resolve OrgDb package name (dropdown or custom text) #set $orgdb_resolved = str($enrich_section.enrich_params.orgdb_package) #if str($enrich_section.enrich_params.orgdb_package) == "custom": #set $orgdb_resolved = str($enrich_section.enrich_params.orgdb_custom) #end if
Rscript '$__tool_directory__/wgcna.R'
## ── Required ────────────────────────────────────────────────── --vst_matrix '$vst_matrix' --sample_info '$sample_info'
## ── Column names ────────────────────────────────────────────── --sample_col '$col_names.sample_col' --treatment_col '$col_names.treatment_col' #if str($col_names.case_label): --case_label '$col_names.case_label' #end if
## ── Filtering ───────────────────────────────────────────────── --presence_pct '$filtering.presence_pct' --var_percentile '$filtering.var_percentile'
## ── Network ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── --soft_power '$network.soft_power' --network_type '$network.network_type' --min_module_size '$network.min_module_size' --merge_cut_height '$network.merge_cut_height' --max_block_size '$network.max_block_size' --n_threads '$network.n_threads'
## ── Thresholds ──────────────────────────────────────────────── --kme_threshold '$thresholds.kme_threshold' --cor_threshold '$thresholds.cor_threshold' --tom_percentile '$thresholds.tom_percentile'
## ── DEG overlap (optional) ──────────────────────────────────── #if $deg_section.use_degs == "yes": --up_degs '$deg_section.up_degs' --down_degs '$deg_section.down_degs' #else: --up_degs None --down_degs None #end if
## ── Gene Ontology / Enrichment (optional) ───────────────────── #if $enrich_section.run_enrichment == "yes": --run_enrichment yes --orgdb_package '$orgdb_resolved' --gene_id_type '$enrich_section.enrich_params.gene_id_type' --enrich_pval_cut '$enrich_section.enrich_params.enrich_pval_cut' --enrich_qval_cut '$enrich_section.enrich_params.enrich_qval_cut' --enrich_min_gs '$enrich_section.enrich_params.enrich_min_gs' --enrich_max_gs '$enrich_section.enrich_params.enrich_max_gs' #if $enrich_section.enrich_params.run_kegg: --run_kegg yes --kegg_organism '$enrich_section.enrich_params.kegg_organism' #else: --run_kegg no #end if --out_enrich_dir enrichment_output --out_table_go_summary '$out_table_go_summary' --out_plot_go_dot '$out_plot_go_dot' --out_plot_go_bar '$out_plot_go_bar' #else: --run_enrichment no --orgdb_package none --out_enrich_dir enrichment_output --out_table_go_summary '$out_table_go_summary' --out_plot_go_dot '$out_plot_go_dot' --out_plot_go_bar '$out_plot_go_bar' #end if
## ── Module Preservation / Z-summary (optional) ──────────────── #if $pres_section.run_preservation == "yes": --run_preservation yes --ref_vst_matrix '$pres_section.ref_vst_matrix' --ref_sample_info '$pres_section.ref_sample_info' --ref_sample_col '$pres_section.pres_params.ref_sample_col' --ref_treatment_col '$pres_section.pres_params.ref_treatment_col' --pres_n_perms '$pres_section.pres_params.pres_n_perms' --pres_max_genes '$pres_section.pres_params.pres_max_genes' --pres_random_seed '$pres_section.pres_params.pres_random_seed' #else: --run_preservation no --ref_vst_matrix None --ref_sample_info None #end if --out_table_preservation '$out_table_preservation' --out_plot_zsummary '$out_plot_zsummary' --out_plot_pres_heatmap '$out_plot_pres_heatmap' --out_table_pres_class '$out_table_pres_class'
## ── Core outputs ────────────────────────────────────────────── --out_plot_clustering '$out_plot_clustering' --out_plot_soft '$out_plot_soft' --out_plot_dendro '$out_plot_dendro' --out_plot_heatmap_all '$out_plot_heatmap_all' --out_plot_mm_gs '$out_plot_mm_gs' --out_plot_hubs '$out_plot_hubs' --out_plot_heatmap_sel '$out_plot_heatmap_sel' --out_plot_deg_bar '$out_plot_deg_bar' --out_table_modules '$out_table_modules' --out_table_gs_mm '$out_table_gs_mm' --out_table_hubs '$out_table_hubs' --out_table_sel_modules '$out_table_sel_modules' --out_table_deg_summary '$out_table_deg_summary' --out_cytoscape_dir cytoscape_output --out_rdata '$out_rdata'
2>&1 | tee '$out_log'

param.name: vst_matrix
param.label: VST-normalized expression matrix
param.help: Tab-separated; first column = gene IDs. Remaining columns = samples; header = sample IDs.

param.name: sample_info
param.label: Sample metadata
param.help: Tab-separated with at minimum SampleID and Treatment columns (configurable below).

param.name: case_label
param.label: Case group label (optional)
param.help: The group to encode as 1 in the trait vector (e.g. 'Induced'). Auto-detected if blank.

param.name: up_degs
param.label: Up-regulated gene list
param.help: No header required. First column = gene IDs matching the expression matrix.

param.name: run_enrichment
param.label: Gene Ontology / functional enrichment analysis
param.option: Yes — run GO enrichment on selected modules

param.name: run_preservation
param.label: Module preservation analysis (Z-summary)
param.option: Yes — compare modules to a reference network

param.name: ref_vst_matrix
param.label: Reference VST expression matrix
param.help: The 'reference' or 'healthy' dataset against which module preservation is tested. Same format as the main VST matrix.

param.name: ref_sample_info
param.label: Reference sample metadata
param.help: Metadata for the reference dataset (same format as the main metadata).

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool performs a complete **Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA)** pipeline on VST-normalized RNA-seq data, with two optional advanced analyses:
1. **Gene Ontology / functional enrichment** on each detected module 2. **Module preservation** (Z-summary) to compare co-expression structure between two biological conditions (e.g. pathogen-infected vs. healthy, or across species)
-----
**Pipeline overview**
Steps performed:
1. Load and align data (VST matrix + sample metadata) 2. Filter: presence filter + variance percentile filter 3. Build trait matrix (binary: case vs. control) 4. Sample clustering (outlier detection) 5. Soft-threshold selection (scale-free topology) 6. Blockwise network construction (signed/unsigned TOM) 7. Module eigengenes + module-trait Pearson r 8. Gene significance (GS) + module membership (kME) for the top module 9. Hub gene identification (top 10% intramodular connectivity) 10. kME filtering (kME > threshold) 11. Cytoscape export for high-correlation modules 12. Module-trait heatmap for selected modules 13. DEG overlap (optional) 14. GO / KEGG enrichment per module (optional) 15. Module preservation / Z-summary (optional)
-----
**Input formats**
VST expression matrix (tabular):
GeneID Sample_A1 Sample_A2 Sample_B1 Sample_B2 AT1G01010 8.23 7.95 5.12 5.44 AT1G01020 6.10 6.35 9.87 10.02
Sample metadata (tabular):
SampleID Treatment Sample_A1 Infected Sample_A2 Infected Sample_B1 Healthy Sample_B2 Healthy
-----
**Gene Ontology / Enrichment Analysis**
When enabled, runs ``enrichGO`` (GO Biological Process, Molecular Function, Cellular Component) and optionally ``enrichKEGG`` on each selected module using ``clusterProfiler``.
- **OrgDb package** — select the Bioconductor organism annotation package matching your species (e.g. ``org.Hs.eg.db`` for human, ``org.At.tair.db`` for Arabidopsis). Custom packages are also supported. - **Gene ID type** — must match the row names in your expression matrix (SYMBOL, ENSEMBL, ENTREZID, TAIR, etc.) - **KEGG** — requires an internet connection and the 3-letter KEGG organism code (e.g. ``hsa``, ``mmu``, ``ath``, ``sce``)
Outputs include a combined GO summary table, per-module TSV files, a dot plot, and a bar plot of the top enriched Biological Process terms per module.
-----
**Module Preservation / Z-summary (Step 15)**
Answers the question: *"Does a co-expression module identified in condition A also exist in condition B?"* — for example, comparing a pathogen-infected organism to a healthy reference, or comparing two different species.
Uses WGCNA's ``modulePreservation()`` function, which calculates composite Z-statistics based on TOM density, connectivity, and correlation structure.
**Z-summary interpretation:**
- **Zsummary < 2** — module structure is lost in the reference (not preserved) - **Zsummary 2 to 10** — module partially conserved (moderately preserved) - **Zsummary > 10** — same module exists in both conditions (highly preserved)
**Required inputs:**
- **Reference VST matrix** — expression data from the reference condition (e.g. healthy tissue, wild-type, or a different organism) - **Reference sample metadata** — same format as the main metadata
The tool automatically finds genes shared between the two datasets and runs the preservation test on those.
-----
**Outputs summary**
*Plots*
- Sample clustering plot — outlier check - Soft-threshold plot — power selection guidance - Gene dendrogram — module color assignments - Full module-trait heatmap — all modules vs all traits - MM vs GS scatter plot — top module relevance validation - Hub gene plot — connectivity vs kME - Selected modules heatmap — high-correlation modules - DEG distribution barplot *(optional)* — DEG overlap per module - GO dot plot *(optional)* — top GO-BP terms per module - GO bar plot *(optional)* — enrichment bars per module - Z-summary scatter plot *(optional)* — module preservation overview - Preservation statistics heatmap *(optional)* — multi-statistic view
*Tables (TSV)*
- Module gene assignments — all genes with module colors - Gene significance and module membership — top module statistics - Hub genes — hub gene list with connectivity scores - Selected modules summary — modules passing the correlation threshold - DEG overlap summary *(optional)* — DEG counts per network module - GO combined summary *(optional)* — all significant GO terms - GO per-module files *(optional)* — one TSV per module per ontology - KEGG per-module files *(optional)* — KEGG pathways per module - Module preservation statistics *(optional)* — Zsummary, Zdensity, Zconnectivity - Module preservation classification *(optional)* — Not/Moderate/Highly preserved
*Other*
- Cytoscape networks (collection) — edge and node files per module - R workspace (RData) — all objects for downstream use - Analysis log
-----
**References**
- Langfelder P, Horvath S. WGCNA: an R package for weighted gene co-expression network analysis. *BMC Bioinformatics* 2008, 9:559. https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-9-559
- Langfelder P, Luo R, Oldham MC, Horvath S. Is my network module preserved and reproducible? *PLoS Computational Biology* 2011, 7(1):e1001057. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1001057
- Yu G et al. clusterProfiler: a universal enrichment tool for interpreting omics data. *The Innovation* 2021, 2(3):100141. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xinn.2021.100141
